title: Tensor category of $\mathbb{Z}_2$-orbifold of Heisenberg vertex operator algebra and its applications
summary: In this paper, we prove the category of finite length modules for the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-orbifold $M(1)^+$ of the Heisenberg vertex operator algebra whose simple composition factors are $M(1)^\pm$ or $M(1,λ)$ for $λ\in \mathbb{C}^\times$ is a vertex and braided tensor category. Our strategy is to show these simple composition factors are $C_1$-cofinite and the category of finite length $M(1)^+$-modules is exactly the category of grading-restricted $C_1$-cofinite modules. We also determine the fusion product decompositions of simple objects and prove the rigidity of this category. As an…
